reason: Zod JIT fastpass bug could cause the optional+overwrite validation field behavior described to be misordered; base runs BEFORE the fix.
After the Zod object JIT fastpass fix, an optional property with an extra validation rule that may overwrite should be omitted cleanly.
Before the fix, a tab-only separator line in paragraph parsing is not treated as a blank-line separator, so text is rendered as one paragraph.
The fix treats a line of only tab characters as a blank line, splitting the two surrounding text lines into two paragraph elements.
JSON success-body parsing is unrelated to non-string stack decoration; expected normal axios behavior.
Same default JSON response behavior applies after PR; the PR targets a different code path.
Boolean flag recognition is independent of the uppercase E exponent fix; behavior should be intact.
Boolean flag recognition still works after the unrelated exponent fix.
Before the fix, JsonTreeReader silently accepted non-ASCII full-width digit characters as integers.
After the fix, JsonTreeReader.nextInt rejects non-ASCII digit characters in string values.
Without the config-quoting fix, a hyphen-containing schema name is tokenized incorrectly and breaks the SET search_path statement.
After the fix, a schema name like 'test-db' is treated as a single identifier in the SET search_path SQL.
Transformation eligibility for an ImageView load is unrelated to the ByteBufferUtil resource-leak fix.
Transformation eligibility should still work after the resource-leak fix.
Caching allowedSymbolsAndAlphanumerics is a perf change; behavior of accepting extra allowed symbols should remain.
Identical behavior expected after the unrelated caching change.
Cstdint inclusion for GCC 15 is a compile-time fix; SVG data-URI runtime behavior is unchanged.
Datetime DST shift behavior is unaffected by the afrikaans locale PR which only adds weeks.
Same rationale as the base/head pair; SVG loading works on both sides.
Cookie header parsing fix is unrelated to form-urlencoded empty-body decoding for optional fields.
Same expected default behavior.
Spelling-only fix; in-memory filesystem Remove semantics unchanged.
Identical expected behavior after the spelling-only fix.
Index rename comparison ambiguity with multiple equal candidates is a separate bug not fixed by this PR; behavior at base likely does not handle this correctly.
Unrelated JSON-flags-depth fix doesn't change index-rename behavior; the ambiguous rename case still fails.
Datetime DST arithmetic is unrelated to the afrikaans locale weeks change.
Before the permit-leak fix, lowering the configured limit below existing available permits could cause replenishment to stop.
After the fix, permits are replenished correctly even after the limit is lowered.
Prefer-template ASI hazard fix is unrelated; var→block-scoped autofix hoisting scenario behaves normally.
Block-scoped declaration behavior with function declaration indirection is unchanged by the prefer-template fix.
Log formatter fix is unrelated to SitemapSpider job-dir resume behavior.
Spider restart and 'still crawling' condition is independent of the log formatter PR.
Bat's sanitization of bidi control chars is unrelated to double-width character handling at narrow terminal widths.
Full-row theme with double-width chars should still not crash after bidi sanitization fix.
RFC5424 syslog parsing optimization is unrelated to per-key symlink creation in file output plugin.
Follow-up record updating symlink is independent of the syslog parsing PR.
ConcurrentBag virtual-thread-yield spin fix is unrelated to HikariCP pool's System property access.
Concurrent pool-name generation deadlock avoidance is independent of the virtual-thread spin change.
32-bit Redis background-save issue may persist at base unrelated to ACL SORT fix; behavior of saving a multi-MB RDB after this PR is uncertain.
systemd-managed 32-bit RDB save may still fail at base/head regardless of the ACL SORT PR; uncertain, lean FAIL.
Neovim CTRL-A behavior unrelated to the nvim_win_set_buf CWD fix; the number increment behaves normally.
Neovim CTRL-X behavior independent of the CWD fix.
DuckDB array concat NULL handling is unrelated to file-cache race condition fix.
list_concat vs || operator type agreement independent of file cache fix.
RefCounted subclass NOTIFICATION_PREDELETE handling independent of ScrollBar drag scrolling fix.
RefCounted release-during-predelete independent of ScrollBar fix.
Constant-column regression F-score is independent of categorical-feature error raising.
Near-constant column sqrt warning is independent of categorical-feature error raising.
Vault Agent file sink octal-mode behavior independent of the Swagger UI input fix.
mode=0600 file permission independent of Swagger UI fix.
Before the HelpFormatter fix, a command with no options may produce a usage line with spurious extra characters (or empty program name).
After the fix, HelpFormatter.write_usage produces a clean 'Usage: cli' as the first line.
Returning dict→JSON behavior is independent of the IPv6 partition fix.
Identical default dict-to-JSON behavior after the IPv6 fix.
Required-field-missing validation behavior independent of the unhashable generic-alias core schema PR.
Same expected missing-field validation behavior.
logging.WARN→logging.WARNING renaming should preserve existing engine echo-flag behavior.
Same default engine logging behavior after rename.
Computed attribute access latency likely unaffected by lazy attribute thread-safety fix.
Same expected latency comparison behavior.
TraceableEventDispatcher per-invocation logging should still work; unrelated to memory leak fix.
Per-invocation dispatch logging still functional after the memory leak fix.
Shell completion current-command context is unrelated to shellcheck error cleanups.
Same completion hook behavior expected.
At base, before the qs@6.14.0 update, repeated query keys > 20 times collapse into a single value rather than an array.
After updating to qs@6.14.0, repeated keys are always preserved as an array regardless of count.
Default get_environ_proxies(url) calling convention is independent of the no_proxy 'proxies' argument fix.
Same expected behavior after the no_proxy fix.
Before the parse_unit_value edge-case fix, a list-literal bare word like '.foons' is misinterpreted (e.g., parsed as a duration or fails).
After the fix, the parser treats '.foons' as a plain string and returns it via 'get 0'.
Before Guzzle's HEAD sink fix, sending HEAD with Accept-Encoding causes cURL to set up a decompression sink that triggers an error.
After the fix, no sink is connected for HEAD, so the request completes cleanly.
ExUnit match failure formatting for an improper-list map is independent of map-formatting-in-list-assertions PR.
Same expected clear diff behavior.
Before the dynamic CSS props hydration fix, the nested dynamic component loses its scoped CSS custom property on re-render.
After the fix, the nested dynamic component retains its scoped CSS custom property across re-renders.
Multi-line new URL(...,import.meta.url) is unrelated to the internal hook-filters refactor; bundling works on both sides.
Same expected bundling behavior after the refactor.
Before the FZF_CURRENT_ITEM export fix, items containing a NUL byte may break preview child-process spawning.
After the fix, preview child processes receive FZF_CURRENT_ITEM correctly and run the preview command.
Before the EdgeToEdge.enable/WindowCompat fix, switching from immersiveSticky back to edgeToEdge fails to restore the system bars.
After the fix, switching back to edgeToEdge properly restores the status and navigation bars.
Before the multiple-assignment syntax-error fix in ruff preview, 'case X(num=a):' is wrongly flagged as a syntax error.
After the fix, class-pattern keyword binding to the same variable name produces no syntax error.
Before the gohcl value-slice decode fix, decoding into a pre-populated list field with two repeated nested blocks does not produce the expected list.
After the fix, value-slice decode correctly handles repeated blocks into a pre-populated list field.
Before the timezone-fallback fix, mocked 'now' does not honor the application's default timezone when the reference moment was created in another zone.
After the fix, mocked 'now' falls back to the application default timezone regardless of the reference moment's zone.
Before the hasProtocol regexp expansion, '///test.com' is mis-classified by the protocol-relative URL detection.
After the fix, unusual leading-slash protocol-relative addresses are classified correctly.
Standard MD5('abc') is unaffected by an internal HashCode.getBytesInternal change.
Same expected MD5 digest behavior.
Interface client code generation is independent of the diagnostics refactor.
Same generation+invocation behavior expected after refactor.
HTTP/1.1 plain response fetch is independent of the redundant 'continue' removal refactor.
Same expected fetch behavior.

After the fix, both default and basic ISO 8601 formatting preserve the custom calendar correctly.

After the fix, ->end and getEndDate() both reflect the updated end date.

English number-to-words is unaffected by an Albanian pluralization fix; both 1M and 2M convert correctly.
Same expected English conversion behavior.
Singleton resolution is independent of the non-String env-property coercion fix.
Same expected singleton behavior.

Same expected behavior.
Size-in-bytes accessor for invalid size strings independent of the max/min refactor.
Same expected behavior.

After the fix, case-insensitive redirect resolves correctly with mixed static+parameterized routes.

After the fix, Int64Value returns 0 rather than crashing.
Quit handling independent of the renderer tab-stops fix.
Same expected prompt-quit behavior.

After the fix, the already-cancelled signal correctly skips the operation.
Case-insensitive search is unrelated to unreachable ignore-file skip optimization.
Same expected search behavior.

Same expected default-value behavior.
